parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistAPIVersionTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.78) reflects two distinct test scenarios — an invalid feature flag and a non-string feature flag — that happen to share structural shape because they both exercise the same fallback behaviour under different preconditions. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure the intent of each individual failure case and couple unrelated test semantics. The restraint rule for test fixtures dominates the action signal here.
